title: Building energy: conflict reconciliation and uncovered thermal lanes
mission: First reconcile the conflicting building-energy--constant-power-electricity-consumption@r1 pair held by two origins with different content: investigate both, select or qualify a canonical relationship, and author an intentional corrected r2 under the existing ID following the correction protocol with both histories preserved. Then continue into uncovered thermal lanes only. Successive batches; no chain required.
priorities: Reconcile constant-power-electricity-consumption@r1 into a corrected r2 with explicit canonical rationale
Degree-day heating demand from loss coefficient and degree-days
Ventilation and infiltration heat loss from air-change rate, volume and temperature difference
Service water-heating energy from volume and temperature lift
Steady combustion efficiency from useful heat and fuel input
boundaries: Already covered, do not resubmit as new coverage under any name: constant-power consumption, sensible heat (two existing wordings), plane-slab conduction (two wordings), layer thermal resistance (three wordings), heat-pump and refrigerator COP, HSPF seasonal performance, mass from density and volume, latent phase-change heat, Carnot heating and cooling limits, series resistance sum, gray-surface radiative exchange. Overlap notes only.

Corrections ship in a separate correction batch: fresh batch ID, r2 under the existing model ID, prior identities and the addressed conflict cited in summary or review notes. Never mix them into a new-domain batch.
Separate energy from power; absolute temperature from temperature difference; point COP from seasonal performance.
No defaults for weather, household size, hours, tariffs, efficiency, climate, or material properties.
Exclude dynamic building simulation, empirical weather forecasts, full HVAC sizing, regulations and equipment recommendations.
starter_sources: https://www.energy.gov -- navigate to building-energy, water-heating and heating-equipment references; the root alone proves nothing
Find an accessible ASHRAE handbook, building-physics textbook or agency degree-day reference for the new lanes; starter links alone do not prove the equation
special_checks: The r2 summary must cite both conflicting prior identities and explain the canonical choice; preserve both histories and flag anything still irreconcilable
Degree-day base temperature and period must be explicit; test a zero degree-day boundary
Air density and specific heat enter as supplied parameters or sourced constants, never hidden assumptions
Combustion efficiency must state higher- vs lower-heating-value basis
integration_expectation: Temperature, pressure and volume dimensions are unsupported: mark requires-extension with full SI units preserved. Degree-day, loss-coefficient and efficiency meanings are new. Scalar forms still validate numerically in the kit. Do not reuse delivered_heat for arbitrary heat stored or electricity for generic energy.
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent source chapters/subtopics inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
